title: Programmatic Motion Graphics Rendering via Node.js Subprocess JSON-RPC and Slotted Models

claims.assertion: Node.js/TypeScript rendering runtimes must be isolated behind headless JSON-RPC subprocess transports adhering to Rule 14 and Rule 56.
claims.evidence: HyperFramesSubprocessBridge drains stderr ring buffers, cleans stdin pipes in finally blocks, preserves loopback sockets, and falls back to headless simulation for CI.

claims.assertion: Slotted frozen dataclasses with validation assertions enforce valid video resolution, non-zero durations, and valid transition types before dispatching subprocess commands.
claims.evidence: VideoScene, RenderRequest, and RenderOutput enforce post-init guards and raise AttributeError upon direct attribute assignment under Rule 43.
